name: TrainYAS
schedule: Mondays and Wednesdays, 6:00–10:00 pm; the cyclists' gate closes at 9:45 pm. A women-only session, TrainYAS Ladies, runs on Tuesdays.

start_location.name: Yas Marina Circuit (cyclists' gate)
start_location.address: Yas Marina Circuit, Yas Island, Abu Dhabi

pace: Your own pace on the Formula 1 circuit

host.name: Yas Marina Circuit, presented by Abu Dhabi Sports Council

visitor_notes: Free, but register online first to get the TrainYAS barcode. Helmets are compulsory. Free loan bikes and helmets (adult and kids' sizes) from Abu Dhabi Cycling Club, limited numbers. Under-18s must come with an adult.
description: Yas Marina Circuit opens its Formula 1 track to cyclists, runners and walkers two evenings a week. You ride laps at your own pace on closed tarmac, and loan bikes are there if you travelled without one. It is free and open to all ages and levels.
evidence: The circuit's TrainYAS page gives Monday and Wednesday 6:00–10:00 pm and shows a session dated Oct 29, 2025; nothing on it is dated 2026 (fetched Sept 30, 2026).

refresh.notes: The page lists upcoming session dates when they are set. The circuit's Ladies page says updates go out on Instagram @ymcofficial.

name: TrainYAS Ladies
schedule: Tuesdays, 6:00–9:00 pm, women only (the last dated session shown ran on the North Circuit).

start_location.name: Yas Marina Circuit
start_location.address: Yas Marina Circuit, Yas Island, Abu Dhabi

pace: Your own pace; cyclists ride anti-clockwise

host.name: Yas Marina Circuit, presented by Abu Dhabi Sports Council

visitor_notes: Women only. Register online for a TrainYAS barcode and show it at the gate. Helmet and closed shoes compulsory. Free loan bikes in adult sizes, first come first served.
description: A women-only evening on the Yas Marina Formula 1 circuit, for cyclists, runners and walkers. Ride laps at your own pace on closed tarmac. Loan bikes are available.
evidence: The circuit's TrainYAS Ladies page gives Tuesdays 6:00–9:00 pm and shows a session dated Oct 7, 2025, with a note that sessions resume in September (fetched Sept 30, 2026).

refresh.notes: The page says to watch Instagram @ymcofficial for restarts after the summer break. Check that a 2026–27 session date has appeared.

name: Saturday Out-Ride
schedule: Every Saturday, 6:00 am, from the first car park on the Al Qudra Cycle Path (meet under the tent). Four distances: 35, 65, 85 and 104 km.

start_location.name: Al Qudra Cycle Path, first car park (under the tent)

pace: Social ride for building strength and group-riding skills; pick your distance
visitor_notes: The shop says all riders are welcome and rents bikes if you travel without one. A support truck with water and mechanical help follows the rides.
description: Revolution Cycles' big Saturday ride on the Al Qudra desert cycle path. Riders pick one of four distances, from 35 km to 104 km, and a support truck follows. It rolls at 6:00 am, before the heat.
evidence: The shop's rides page lists the Saturday 6:00 am ride with no date on it; the shop's rides blog post, dated Dec 19, 2024, gives the same schedule (both fetched Sept 30, 2026).

refresh.notes: Undated page. The shop's rides blog post is dated Dec 19, 2024; ride changes are pushed in the shop's WhatsApp group (joined from the rides page). Ask in the shop (+971 4 369 7441) if the page has not changed in a year.

name: Sunday Coffee Ride
schedule: Every Sunday, 6:00 am, from the first car park on the Al Qudra Cycle Path (meet under the tent). 35 km, or 65 km with a coffee stop.

start_location.name: Al Qudra Cycle Path, first car park (under the tent)

visitor_notes: All ability levels welcome, per the shop. Support truck follows. Bike rental from the shop.
description: The shop calls it the legendary coffee ride: a social Sunday spin on the Al Qudra cycle path. Choose 35 km, or 65 km with a coffee stop. A good first ride in Dubai if you want company more than speed.
evidence: The shop's rides page lists the Sunday 6:00 am coffee ride with no date on it; the shop's rides blog post, dated Dec 19, 2024, gives the same schedule (both fetched Sept 30, 2026).

refresh.notes: Undated page. The shop's rides blog post is dated Dec 19, 2024; ride changes are pushed in the shop's WhatsApp group (joined from the rides page). Ask in the shop (+971 4 369 7441) if the page has not changed in a year.

name: Critical Mass Nairobi
schedule: Monthly on a Saturday: gather 8:30 am at Jeevanjee Gardens, leave 9:00 am sharp. Next listed date: Saturday Oct 31, 2026.

start_location.name: Jeevanjee Gardens
start_location.address: Banda Street, Nairobi CBD (near the Kencom bus stop)

pace: All levels and all bike types
visitor_notes: Free; just turn up by 8:30 am. Bring snacks or cash for stops on the way, and make sure your bike is in working order. The route is shared on the day.
description: Nairobi's monthly community ride, billed as the city's biggest, with hundreds of riders. It leaves Jeevanjee Gardens in the CBD and loops about 30 km through the city. The ride campaigns for cyclist safety under the tag #CyclistsLivesMatter.
evidence: Fit Savanna's event listing gives the 8:30 am Jeevanjee Gardens start and lists the next ride for Saturday Oct 31, 2026 (fetched Sept 30, 2026); the ride's own site has no schedule.

refresh.notes: The listing rolls forward to the next ride date. The ride itself posts on Instagram and Facebook (login walls).

name: Kigali Car Free Day
schedule: Twice a month on Sunday mornings, from 7:00 am until about 10:00–11:00 am. The published rule is the first and third Sunday, but the Sept 2026 edition ran on the second Sunday (Sept 13), so check the City's announcement that week.

start_location.name: Sites in each district (in Sept 2026 the Kicukiro route ran from Sonatube to IPRC-Kigali)

founded_note: Started as a monthly event in 2016 and went to twice a month in 2018, per a May 2026 study.
visitor_notes: Free and open to anyone on foot or on a bike. Some main roads close to cars for the morning; each district runs its own site with aerobics and other sessions. Bring your own bike.
description: Twice a month the City of Kigali closes some main roads to cars on a Sunday morning, and the streets fill with runners, cyclists, families and aerobics groups. It has run since 2016. There is no set route or pace; ride the closed roads and join whatever is on at your district's site.
evidence: KT Press ran a report on the car-free day dated Sunday Sept 13, 2026; a May 28, 2026 study gives the first-and-third-Sunday, 7–11 am pattern (both fetched Sept 30, 2026).

refresh.notes: The City of Kigali announces each edition and its sites on its X account, which needs a login. Local news (KT Press, The New Times) covers most editions; search 'Kigali Car Free Day' plus the month.

name: PPA Weekly Social Rides
schedule: Every Saturday, 6:30 am, from 9 Hill Park Lane, Mowbray: a short group (32–36 km, mostly flat) and an intermediate group (70 km, start point varies weekly). A social group (60–75 km) rides alternate Saturdays and Sundays, 6:30–7:30 am. PPA lists the series from Aug 1, 2026 to Feb 21, 2027.

start_location.name: 9 Hill Park Lane, Mowbray
start_location.address: 9 Hill Park Lane, Mowbray, Cape Town

duration: Short group about 1 h 50 min; social group 4+ hours
pace: Short group: ride captain controls the pace, no one left behind. Social group: averages 20–22 km/h.
visitor_notes: Free and open to non-members. The short group has a backup vehicle and coffee after. The intermediate group needs charged lights, tubes and spares; its start and route are posted in the PPA Social Rides WhatsApp group each week. The social group asks for riders who could finish the Cape Town Cycle Tour in under six hours.
description: Pedal Power Association's free Saturday rides out of Mowbray. The short group rides 32–36 km at a pace the ride captain sets, with a backup vehicle and coffee after; PPA pitches it at newcomers building confidence on the road. Stronger riders can join the 70 km intermediate group or the longer social group.
evidence: PPA's events page lists the weekly social rides from Aug 1, 2026 to Feb 21, 2027, with times and groups (fetched Sept 30, 2026).

refresh.notes: Trust the events page: the older /social-rides/ page still says 7:00 am and a different coffee stop. The listing's date range shows when the season ends; weekly routes go out on the group's WhatsApp on Fridays.
